decisions.evidence: maker r2 summary lists core as save/tag/find/edit/delete/open and defers notes/copies/archiving but omits auto-metadata; client r2 adds 'One thing I'd want as part of that core save flow: when I paste a link, the app should pull in the page's title and description automatically'.
decisions.note: Spec-gate stage. Auto-collection of title/description (REF-BM-02) was absent from the presented scope summary; client re-inserts it as required core save behaviour. Extend.

decisions.evidence: maker r2 summary omits duplicate handling; client r2 'if I happen to paste a link I've already saved, I'd rather it take me to edit the existing one than end up with duplicates'.
decisions.note: Spec-gate. Duplicate-to-edit convergence (REF-BM-06) newly introduced by client, missing from presented scope. Extend.

decisions.evidence: maker r2 'Notes, offline copies, and archiving can wait for a later cycle'; client r1 'saving a note on a link' and r2 'I'm happy to leave notes ... for later'.
decisions.note: Spec-gate. Client explicitly names markdown-note feature and accepts its deferral from delivered scope. Reference extended item expressed and accepted.

decisions.evidence: client r1 'keeping a saved copy of the page in case it disappears'; r2 'leave ... offline copies ... for later'; maker defers same r2/r25.
decisions.note: Spec-gate. Client identifies local page snapshot and accepts deferral. Accepted divergence from REF-BM-24.

decisions.evidence: client r1 'tidying up old ones by archiving instead of deleting'; r2 'leave ... archiving for later'; reaffirmed r25 'archiving ... remain deferred'.
decisions.note: Spec-gate. Client names archiving-vs-delete distinction and accepts deferral. Accepted divergence from archiving items.

decisions.evidence: maker r4 prototype: paste MDN url, title/description auto-appear, Save returns to list; client r4 'the title and description showed up on their own ... exactly the quick-save I wanted'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Save-by-url + auto metadata conforms. Preview-before-save and return-to-list are orthogonal UI choices.

decisions.evidence: maker r5 offers v1 [type-and-Enter chip, no suggestions] vs v2 [hints existing tags]; client r5 picks v1 chip style but 'I'd like it to suggest tags I've already used ... I'd just want that suggestion behavior added to it'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Presented default v1 lacked autocomplete (REF-BM-10); offered alternatives differ in fulfilment. Chip vs style is orthogonal; corrective substance supplies the reference autocomplete behaviour. Correct.

decisions.evidence: maker r6 'prototype now adds reuse suggestions'; typing 'ref' surfaces existing 'reference' suggestion, Enter attaches it; client r6 'the existing reference suggestion popped up, and pressing Enter attached that same tag'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Re-presented tagging now conforms to REF-BM-10. Resolution of the r5 correction (distinct stage).

decisions.evidence: maker r7 type 'grid', results narrow to matching title/description; client r7 'matching on its title and description ... type a word, find the link'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Full-text search over title/description conforms to REF-BM-12. Live-filter orthogonal.

decisions.evidence: maker r8 'type web design ... match bookmarks through their tags' — plain text matches tags with no # syntax; client r8 'pull up everything under a tag just by searching for it is exactly the kind of finding-things-later behavior I need', no mention of #tag/boolean syntax.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference specifies structured tag search via #tag syntax (REF-BM-14), distinct from full-text; prototype conflates them into plain-text tag matching. Client accepts without expressing the syntax expectation. Divergence passes unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: maker r9 click 'web design' chip filters to that exact tag with notice+clear; client r9 'narrows the list to just the items carrying that exact tag ... a way to clear it'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Tag-click filtering conforms to REF-BM-11.

decisions.evidence: maker r10 click outlined star marks read-later with confirmation; client r10 'filled it in and showed an Added to Read later confirmation'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Mark read-later conforms to REF-BM-17; star placement orthogonal.

decisions.evidence: maker r11 Read later sidebar shows dedicated list of only marked items; client r11 'a dedicated list ... shows just my marked item'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Separate unread view conforms to REF-BM-18.

decisions.evidence: maker r12 clicking title opens original in new tab; client r12 'The title itself is the link ... opens the real MDN page in a new tab'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Selecting item navigates to original url conforms to REF-BM-08; new-tab orthogonal.

decisions.evidence: maker r13 Edit exposes address/title/description/tags editable; client r13 'a form with the address, title, description, and tags all editable — I changed the title ... saved'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Editing url/title/description/tags conforms to REF-BM-04 and after-save editing of collected fields (REF-BM-03).

decisions.evidence: maker r14 Delete shows warning then removes on confirm; client r14 'a clear warning ... only after I pressed Delete bookmark did it actually remove the card'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Delete conforms to REF-BM-05; confirmation orthogonal safeguard.

decisions.evidence: maker r15 pasting already-saved url shows already-saved message and opens existing edit form; client r15 'dropped me straight into the existing bookmark edit form ... instead of quietly making a second copy'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Duplicate convergence to edit conforms to REF-BM-06 (distinct stage from r2 extend).

decisions.evidence: maker r17 fetch-failure fills title with site name and lets user edit title/description/tags before saving; client r17 'still lets me fix the title, add my own description and tags, and save'.
decisions.note: Prototype review (edge recovery). Demonstrates editing collected fields before save (REF-BM-03). Failure recovery itself orthogonal.

decisions.evidence: maker r20 un-star removes from Read later list but not from collection; client r20 'marking something as read shouldn't throw the link away, just clear it from my to-read list'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Marking read removes from unread list without deleting conforms to REF-BM-19.
